meta.title: One Print
meta.author: Joe Guadagnino / Lupton Associates
meta.style: Apple product-film rules (from @leomeethewoo's breakdown): black void, one hero object, one loud color, brand type only, invisible cuts on the beat, sparse sound
meta.concept: a print becomes a part: blank -> laser cut -> press-brake fold -> TIG gusset -> sage powder coat -> the lineup -> the ask

shots.visual: black; the bracket's flat pattern draws itself as white line art (SVG in Remotion)
crossfade to the real flat steel blank drifting in the void, light glint (seedance 2.5 from nano_banana_pro keyframe)
fiber laser traces the outline, pierces holes and slot, scrap falls away (start=blank, end=cut keyframe)
press-brake punch descends, flange folds to 90 degrees (start=cut, end=bracket keyframe)
gusset drops in, TIG torch enters, arc, withdraws, seam glows (start=bracket, end=weld keyframe)
glow fades, sage powder coat sweeps across — the only color in the film (start=weld, end=coat keyframe)
four parts slide in: coated bracket, machined housing, wire harness, molded enclosure; LUPTON ASSOCIATES lockup; eyebrow SHEET METAL · MACHINING · PLASTICS · HARNESSES
black; 'Send us the print.' then badge + 'Let's build it together.' (sage) + Luptons.com
shots.vo: Send us the print. Let's build it together. Luptons dot com.

voiceover.source: one continuous seed_audio take on the v9 narrator clone, split only at the narrator's own pauses (silencedetect), RMS-matched to -20 dB, 12 ms fades
voiceover.verified: audio-only transcription of the raw take confirmed every phrase before slicing; assembled master re-verified audio-only

music.bed: op_music.wav — original numpy score, one sub pulse per second, chords every 4 s (Am F C G Am F -> C resolve), riser 15-17 s into the color beat, resolve hit at 24 s; no third-party music, no credit required
music.sfx: subbass on the laser cut (5 s), snap on the fold (9.8 s), resolve on the end card (24 s); native seedance ambience mixed at 0.18-0.22 under cut, fold, weld
